links.comparator_used: Raw LLMs with no retrieval (training knowledge alone): GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4 and GPT-5
links.outcome: Accuracy on a 200-question bariatric surgery benchmark drawn from ASMBS textbook end-of-chapter questions
links.effect: GPT-5: 94.0% with RAG (188/200) vs 87.0% raw (+7.0 pp; +14 questions). GPT-4: 89.5% vs 81.0% (+8.5 pp; +13 questions). GPT-4o-mini: 84.5% vs 70.5% (+14.0 pp; +28 questions).
links.tradeoff: Errors remained: 12 incorrect GPT-5 + RAG answers showed evidence-level mismatch, polarity errors in EXCEPT-type questions, scope misinterpretation, and retrieval salience bias. Procedural technique and complications management stayed at 88.9% each. Cost and latency were not reported.
links.quote: Textbook-augmented RAG produced consistent and significant accuracy gains across all models.
